_notes: aliases.openai: OpenAI's deprecations page lists the four Jan 14, 2027 shutdowns by dated snapshot only. The bare names point to those snapshots, which is how luna-check has reported them since 0.1.0. Other OpenAI rows list their bare names themselves.
exclude_ids: one-word legacy IDs (retired Jan 4, 2024) that are also common English words or names; matching them in any string would cause false positives.
